title: world3 world plan
description: Top-level intent for a multi-bundle world. A world plan describes bounds, tile grid, biomes, allowed biome adjacencies, per-biome data sources, and which perspectives + zoom levels the plan needs to support. Phase F.3 reads a plan and emits one region_request.json per tile + a world_map.json. Phase F.4 audits adjacency-pair transitions at catalog time. Phase F.7 streaming director reads world_map.json at runtime. Schema introduced 2026-05-11 as part of Phase F.2.

schema_version.description: Bumps when the schema changes incompatibly.

id.description: Stable lowercase identifier for this world. Used as the output directory name under world3/worlds/<id>/.

bounds_m.description: World size in meters [x_m, z_m]. Must be an integer multiple of tile_size_m on both axes (the validator checks this).

tile_size_m.description: Square tile size in meters. Phase F.2 starter is 256.0; G may multi-scale per perspective.

seed.description: Plan-level seed. Per-tile seeds are derived deterministically as hash(seed, tile_xy) so re-running produces byte-identical bundles.

id.description: Biome id used in biome_layout + adjacency_rules. Often matches biome_kit but can differ if a plan wants multiple variants of the same kit.

biome_kit.description: Which world3 biome kit this biome maps to. Phase F starter restricts to: alpine, desert, tundra, grassland, temperate_forest.

source.description: Default data source for tiles in this biome. Per-tile overrides go in biome_layout entries. Mirrors region_request.json source field shape (type=procedural|real|hybrid).

primary_material_id.description: Catalog material id used as the biome's primary albedo for F.4 transition-pair audit.

biomes.description: Biomes used in this plan. Every biome referenced in biome_layout must be declared here.

tile_xy.description: Tile grid coordinates [col, row]. World coords are (col * tile_size_m, row * tile_size_m) from the world's SW corner.

biome.description: Biome id (must be declared in biomes[]).

source_override.description: Optional per-tile source override (e.g. one tile is real-DEM while the rest of the biome is procedural). Same shape as biomes[].source.

biome_layout.description: Explicit per-tile biome assignment. Every tile in the world's grid must be assigned (validator checks coverage). Future: noise-driven layouts emit the same shape.

allowed_pairs.description: List of [biome_a, biome_b] pairs allowed to neighbor in the layout. Order-independent. Any pair NOT in this list is forbidden — F.3 refuses to emit bundles if the layout puts a forbidden pair next to each other (4-connected adjacency: N/S/E/W of each tile).

self_neighbor_allowed.description: Whether a biome may neighbor itself. Almost always true.

perspectives.description: Which view modes this plan needs to support. Drives capture stage selection in F.3 + Phase G.2 introduces 25d.

distance_m.description: Nominal camera distance from terrain in meters. Used by G.1 capture-framing heuristics.

zoom_levels.description: Optional zoom bands the plan supports. Phase F.2 reserves the field; Phase G.1 wires actual LOD emission. Empty array means single default zoom.

style_pack.description: Style pack id applied to every captured tile by default. Must exist in world3/jobs/style_packs/<id>.json.
